objective: Recover code structure and contracts needed for map read, consistent backup, bounded editing and reliable restore.

policy.inputs: Tracked firmware and existing baseline are immutable; preserve existing untracked files.
policy.execution: Static analysis and saved-data checks only; no device access or original firmware execution.
policy.isolation: One writer and private Ghidra projects per explicit Git worktree.
policy.publication: Workers commit lane-only evidence; parent reviews and cherry-picks completed slices. No push.
policy.integration: Parent owns shared annotations, manifest, replay tooling, RESULTS and cross-lane conclusions; integrate only after durable component handoffs.
policy.acceptance: Instruction-backed, hash-bound, replayable findings; static evidence never implies runtime restore safety. Fresh read-only review follows integration.

lanes.decision: Correlate map IPC requests/results and startup selection.
lanes.contract: RoboController task bridge, AppProxy completion/error paths, navigation startup and load completion; excludes metadata algorithm functions.
lanes.gate: Focused generated C, instruction evidence, identities and replay commands; identify completion strength and cold-start file selection.
lanes.next: Follow native (3,2) decoder/completion; do not substitute the distinct controller (1,2) route.

lanes.decision: Establish all-writer stop/restart and watchdog constraints.
lanes.contract: WatchDoge and startup/process configuration; UART/kernel/MCU provenance and heartbeat dependencies.
lanes.gate: Evidence-backed writer inventory and lifecycle graph; separate proven userspace behavior from unverified hardware behavior.
lanes.next: Trace rr_loader plugin ownership, heartbeat producer and writer-specific SIGHUP handling.

lanes.decision: Bound safe grid edits and metadata regeneration requirements.
lanes.contract: Persistence region setters/readers, segmentation and room-ID regeneration; opaque regions 6, 13 and 14; excludes navigation IPC/startup.
lanes.gate: Instruction-backed dependency/coordinate contracts and saved-data checks; explicit preservation versus regeneration rules.
lanes.next: Trace post-ID-processing reconciliation and actual name-mapping writer; opaque regions remain unresolved.

lanes.decision: Define complete backup set, completion barriers and disk/cache freshness.
lanes.contract: Persistence task completion/state 6, file/catalog/database dependencies, grid cache invalidation and companion vmap/config state; excludes supervisor and request bridge implementation.
lanes.gate: Evidence-backed file/dependency manifest and ordering/barrier graph, distinguishing disk visibility, snapshot consistency and durability.
lanes.next: Resolve DB opener/journal and vmap/config dependencies; state-6 producers remain unresolved.
